Subject: Vendor onboarding — required privacy/security artifacts

Hi Irene,

Thanks for moving NovaFlow through your onboarding pipeline. Procurement has a short checklist we need returned before we can issue a PO and start billing:

- Signed DPA (we can accept a countersigned customer DPA or your standard DPA)
- SOC 2 report or a hosted link to an auditor attestation
- Current subprocessor inventory (comma-separated list + region of processing)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (billing contact + remit-to + tax info)

I attached our onboarding form for completion (NovaFlow_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood has a standard DPA that we can sign, or if you prefer us to sign your customer-facing DPA? Also send the SOC 2 link and subprocessor inventory CSV.

We'd like to have everything by EOD PT Monday to avoid a delay in the first invoice.

Best,
Lucia Ramos
Head of Procurement, NovaFlow
Attachment: NovaFlow_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45 KB)
